_comment: Example per-board analysis config for a hypothetical board: a 12 V input on J1 (net VIN) through fuse F1 onto +12V, which feeds output connectors J2-J5 and a 5 V buck U2 (output inductor L1); a 3.3 V buck U3 (output inductor L2) feeds the MCU U1 and a radio module U4. Every ref, pad and net here is a placeholder: replace them with your own board's, after reading netlist.md, and delete entries that do not apply. Regexes match KiCad net names exactly as they appear in netlist.md (sheet-local nets look like /Power/NAME); the first matching rule wins. Power runs: the source pad is held at 0 V and each sink draws its amps; negative amps inject current (ground returns). Optional per run: h (grid pitch, mm) and region [x0, y0, x1, y1] (only copper inside the box is solved). rail_voltages gives the voltage of rails whose name does not contain it.
